text: 839 writes a separator containing sender and time, substitutes "-" for an unknown sender, replaces whitespace with hyphens, and formats the date in GMT with US-English names and CRLF. This is storage syntax, so locale-sensitive UI formatting would change the file format. A zero envelope time is replaced with PR_Now rather than stored as an unknown sentinel. No external mbox specification page was opened in this batch.
title: Write mbox envelope metadata in a stable storage format
